body.p: One day a pygmy and his child went for a walk. They collected some eseli nuts. On the way they met a satani. The satani put a nut on the child's head and split the nut with a machetti. "Oh!" said the pygmy, "That's like the circumcision school. Tomorrow I'll collect some more nuts and try that." The next day he went with his child to the same place and collected some more eseli nuts. He put one of the nuts on his child's head and hit it with his machetti. He killed his child dead. The satani, who had been watching, said, "See! You have killed your child." The pygmy left his child's body there, and went down to the river. The satani went with him. The satani threw his spear into the water. The pygmy said, "I'd like to do that!" But when he tried the spear went all over the place, everywhere except into the water. He said, "When you do it, satani, it goes straight, yet when I do it it goes all over the place." They left each other. Basi ['That is all'].
